title: Promises, made verifiable.
narration: Meet Horkos. Built to complement Ascend with verifiable pledges around a token launcher’s trading-fee income.

title: Follow the fees.
narration: Ascend creates ongoing fee income for token launchers. Horkos adds accountability: pledge that income, enforce deposited funds, and give holders public evidence.

title: Make the oath.
narration: Connect on Elysium Testnet. Enter a registered token. Choose vesting or burn, set immutable terms, and confirm. Creation deploys a vault and routes creator fees into it.

title: A trade. A fee. A vault.
narration: Ascend’s default model inspires this mock flow. One thousand OATH of volume produces ten in fees. The launcher’s twenty-five percent share, two point five, reaches the vault.

title: Time is the promise.
narration: Vesting locks fees through a one-day cliff, then unlocks linearly through day thirty. Anyone can settle. The launcher cannot rewrite the terms.

title: A share, committed.
narration: Burn settlement sends fifty percent to the dead address, and the rest to the launcher. A dead-address transfer leaves total supply unchanged.

title: Inspect the public record.
narration: Now the deployed records. Oath one holds seven point five OATH. Inspect its schedule, vault, checked block, and transaction history without connecting a wallet.

title: Settlement, on chain.
narration: Oath two has settled three point seven five OATH to each destination. Its status remains Active because the commitment period is still running.

title: A broken promise leaves a mark.
narration: Redirecting future fees permanently marks an oath Breached, even if routing is restored. Existing deposits retain their original terms. This scene illustrates that behavior.

title: One verdict. Anyone can verify.
narration: The public API exposes the verdict, amounts, checked block, and fee source. Other apps can verify the evidence without a wallet.

title: Real vaults. Mock fee source.
narration: Real testnet vaults, mock fee routing. Tokens were deployed directly. Next, validate Ascend integration so its launchers can make these commitments around actual fee income.

title: Make the pledge specific.
narration: Ascend launches the token. Horkos makes the fee pledge verifiable. Inspect the pledge. Follow the fees.
